user.title: Connect to LabTether Hub
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to an existing LabTether hub. HTTPS is required except for loopback addresses. Enable insecure HTTP only when you explicitly accept sending the API key without transport encryption; use the TLS toggle only when you intentionally trust a self-signed certificate.
